The evidence explicitly states in the notes section: 'No synchronization is needed because each Global ID (GID) owns its volume element.' In OpenCL, the Global ID (GID) is derived from the work-item's coordinates (x, y, z) within the global NDRange. Since the mapping strategy assigns one work-item to one voxel, the GID directly corresponds to the voxel coordinates. Therefore, the claim that voxel coordinates are derived from GID is supported by the text.
